notes.title: TOYS FACTORY UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280083/19d087840a2319619ebca07b9d9f07630a4ab31a.png[/img]

Christmas has arrived on Elevator 25!!! Immerse yourself in the horror atmosphere that joins that of the holidays with this special Christmas update full of surprises.

Discover new exclusive content, theme anomalies, festive decorations and much more to celebrate the disturbing magic of Christmas like never before!

[b][h2]What's new?[/h2][/b]
🎅🏻 New Christmas-themed Missions and Events: find all the new themed anomalies and run away from the room!!!

🌟 Festive Settings: Enjoy a new room decorated with sparkling lights, you will feel like you are in a real toy workshop .... or so it seems

❄ New Game Mechanics: new enemies to defeat and new techniques to use to survive.

[b][h2]Key Points[/h2][/b]
A Christmas Like You'Ve Never Seen! Explore the atmosphere of the holidays turned into a nightmare. Christmas lights, gifts and caroles... but with a dark side that will keep you on your breath.

Suspense and Adrenaline with a Festive Theme. Face creepy creatures dressed as Santa Claus, evil elves and monstrous snowmen in an environment full of tension and suspense.

Perfect for the holidays. A unique experience for those looking for an alternative to the traditional Christmas spirit. Get ready to live parties ... chilling!

Suitable for Horror Lovers. If you love horror games and are looking for a creative and themed twist, this is the perfect title for you!

"This Christmas, the only gift will be your survival!"

[b][h2]Bug Fix[/h2][/b]
- fixed camera sensitivity
- fixed some anomalies bugs

[h2][b]Warning[/b][/h2]
⚠ Due to the introduction of a new save system, save data created before this update will no longer be compatible and will be deleted.
